scope: No src/config edits while timing-only B/C runtime is fixed; this design creates no checkpoint and starts no simulation.

target_reward_opt_in.exact_validation: Both keys absent in source reward config; target parsed YAML equals source plus exactly these two keys. target capture_settle_window_s equals the selected nominal-reference task spec transfer_roles.window_s and exact0.5.

source_checkpoint_policy: Use the actually selected immutable compatible checkpoint (initial candidate167424); do not roll back or hardcode a global decision counter.

proposed_api.timing_plan: Absolute existing timing-only plan path only when source checkpoint predates the nominal sequence opt-in; null for an already-timed source with identical nominal bytes.
proposed_api.nominal_reference_manifest: Immutable completed same-N run manifest containing the actual runtime_contract, e.g. completed frozen C after the same-version B/C pair. Record its path and SHA256. Do not require task success, a media hash,5/5, or a new actor probe.

reward_only_source_already_timed: Validate the immutable source checkpoint/manifest using the existing metadata loader, canonical v3 N1 HISTORY372/12, fixed preprocessing, source training configuration and full state hashes.
Require source and nominal-reference provider/spec bytes to match, and source nominal.sequence_semantics to be the reviewed timing mode.
Require source reward source/config hashes to equal the nominal-reference hashes before the body opt-in.
Validate nominal-reference→target as only the body reward change plus its two compatibility modules.
Load directly from the original selected checkpoint, retaining full state; do not synthesize or materialize an intermediate checkpoint.
combined_source_still_pre_timing: Read the actual nominal-reference runtime contract from the completed same-N run manifest; validate its contract digest and bindings.
Validate the already-created timing-only migration plan against the same original checkpoint and nominal-reference runtime contract.
This reuses the existing exact one-key sequence opt-in and NominalMotionProvider-class-only proof, rather than re-authorizing arbitrary nominal edits in the reward factor.
Validate nominal-reference→target as only the body reward change plus two compatibility modules; provider/spec must match the completed B/C reference exactly.
Record the verified timing-plan path/SHA and intermediate contract digest inside the body-reward factor. Restore original checkpoint once with no intermediate optimizer update.
decomposition.fixed_metadata: Frozen A, topology, observation/action dimensions, HISTORY kernel, rates120/15, horizon200, runtime/library versions, actuator/physics configuration, training budget accounting and PPO hyperparameters remain identical.

exact_paths.other_files: No added/removed runtime files; all other runtime file hashes unchanged versus reference. Other five selected configs remain byte-identical to reference.

reward_code_scope.loader_change: Exactly one _validate_carry_body_allowance(v) call; all prior loader checks retained.
reward_code_scope.evaluate_change: Initialize body_transfer_fraction from existing transfer_fraction; under exact opt-in use max(existing fraction, helper(task, window)); only the body motion_weight line switches from transfer_fraction to body_transfer_fraction.
retain_exact_existing_paths: contact uses the original transfer_fraction and unchanged contact calculation
applied smoothness and its diagnostic derivatives
reward_code_scope.guard_recommendation: Implement an exact reviewed source-delta guard for those named constant/helper insertions, loader call and body weighting replacement. Record source/target helper/body-region SHA256. Reject changes to unrelated evaluate statements or other helpers. Do not whitelist the entire reward class/evaluate method.
reward_code_scope.pending: Final exact byte regions must be taken from the reward agent's final unapplied patch, not guessed from this design.

timing_validator_historical_target_readb: To revalidate an already published timing plan after the reward files have changed, use the existing _version_bytes(project_root,target_contract,path,prefer_worktree=True) for target config/provider/changed-file reads instead of assuming target is the current worktree.
This is hash-bound Git fallback, not a synthetic contract or source override. Recomputed old timing plans must remain byte-for-byte identical and no runtime writes occur.
The final current target must still be obtained from clean committed runtime_contract and independently match actual current target hashes.
minimal_implementation_changes.new_factor: A single private _body_reward_factor returning source/target canonical observation_contract, verified reference+optional timing plan bindings, exact reward delta, optimizer preservation and explicit changed reward/MDP semantics.
minimal_implementation_changes.plan_builder: Add one optional body_reward_review branch before the current instrumentation-only dispatcher. Do not add reward/provider/config to INSTRUMENTATION_FILES. Reject video/evaluator/execution/prior/warm-start factors mixed with this branch. Timing composition is only via the validated existing plan described above.
minimal_implementation_changes.plan_validator: Rebuild the body factor from the bound review manifest and optional existing timing plan, compare entire supplied plan exactly, and fail if either referenced artifact changed.
minimal_implementation_changes.loader: Treat body_reward_factor.observation_contract as the alternative reviewed HISTORY372 contract. Keep it exclusive of video/instrumentation/top-level timing factors; the optional timing ancestor lives inside this factor. Reuse current full-state hash verification and fresh-rollout checks.

receipt_semantics.nominal_changed_since_source_checkpoint: True only in the combined pre-timing-source case; include the verified earlier timing factor rather than claiming reward caused it.
receipt_semantics.learned_function_preservation: Identical complete input schema and parameter mapping; no claim of identical actions on changed physical trajectories.
receipt_semantics.optimizer: Keep complete nonempty Adam state, group options and effective source LR; no reset_all_moments.
receipt_semantics.evaluation_normalizer: frozen identity normalizer, no validation updates

proposed_tests: Old timing-only plan validates identically against its committed reference after current reward code/config change.
Pure reward migration from an already-timed synthetic checkpoint preserves canonical372/12 and all source counters.
Combined migration from a pre-timing synthetic checkpoint validates the existing timing plan then the body-only delta without constructing an intermediate model.
Reject wrong/missing/orphan reward keys, wrong settle value, or settle window inconsistent with selected task transfer window.

Reject provider/spec change after reference, selected action/observation/profile changes, arbitrary reward evaluate edits, missing/mutated reference manifest, or timing-plan source/checkpoint mismatch.
Reject a combined source without a verified timing ancestor; reject fabricated same-MDP/instrumentation labels.
Real CPU synthetic save/load test preserves all actor/critic tensors, nonempty Adam hash, identity normalizers, RNG, counters and LR; stale rollout is rejected.
One fresh CPU synthetic update/save/reload succeeds and records the composed provenance; this is not real Isaac PPO credit.
Existing timing/video/instrumentation/capture migrations remain unchanged when body_reward_review is absent.
not_to_do: Do not apply this design or reward patch while the active same-N B/C runtime is running.
Do not hand-edit checkpoint metadata, fake source/target contracts or label the changed reward as instrumentation-only.
Do not use --new-mdp-warm-start because the current same372 path resets Adam.
Do not attribute frozen same-N actor outputs to the new reward; actual learning claims require fresh finite PPO updates and reloaded evaluation.
